Rae (People Ops): Omar's supplemental pay for relocation was posted as non-taxable. Heiled assignment as "short-term foreign" but we still need US withholding. Can payroll confirm?
Jordan (Payroll): Send run id and emp id. Ian check classification.
Rae (People Ops): Run pr-2026-04-02-11, emp 51490. Paystub shows: Relocation Allowance 1200.00 non-taxable.
Omar Fahmy: It was a stipend to cover temporary housing in Lisbon for 3 weeks. I selected "assignment stipend" on the relocation request.
Jordan (Payroll): Looks like the import used legacy stipend code (non-taxable). I'll reclassify, run an off-cycle, and calculate retro withhold. If net was paid already we'll process reversal + taxed earning.
Leah (Tax Counsel): FYI if this increases W-2 wages for 2026 we may need to issue a W-2c. Also check resident state withholding (Omar's home state NY).
PayrollBot: Payroll import pr-2026-04-02-11: 1 record flagged (emp 51490) for manual review.
Rae (People Ops): Thanks. Please post estimated impact before processing so we can advise Omar.
Jordan (Payroll): Will do TA EOD. If company error, we can evaluate gross-up options to cover tax burden.
